 Ben Shelton 1 – 0 Live Arthur Fils Live Updated a minute ago Ben Shelton vs Arthur Fils LIVE, Live Score and Match Updates in ATP Finals (1-0)
 Follow Ben Shelton vs Arthur Fils live from Inalpi Arena in Turin: 2026 Nitto ATP Finals round-robin set-by-set score updates, aces and live tennis stats.
 Coverage by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta Updated November 15, 2026, 3:23 pm ET ADVERTISEMENT
 Live Last update 3:23 PM ET 3:22 PM ET a minute ago End of Set 1: Shelton takes the set 6-2 over Fils
 Set 1 goes to Ben Shelton (6-2)! Executing cleanly on the big points at Inalpi Arena , Ben Shelton wraps up Set 1 against Arthur Fils to put the overall set tally at Shelton 1-0 Fils . Across all rallies played so far, Shelton has claimed 33/56 (59%) points to 23/56 (41%) for Fils .
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 Follow VAVEL on Google 3:20 PM ET 4 minutes ago Shelton closes in on Set 1 at 5-2 against Fils
 Ben Shelton moves out to a 5-2 lead over Arthur Fils in the opening set at the Nitto ATP Finals . Shelton has struck 1 ace so far to 2 from Fils .
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta

 Another game goes on the board for Ben Shelton , who holds a 4-2 advantage over Arthur Fils in the opening set (Shelton 0-0 Fils in sets).

 Baseline exchanges continue at Inalpi Arena with Set 1 at 1-1 between Ben Shelton and Arthur Fils at the Nitto ATP Finals . Total points won stand at 12/26 (46%) to 14/26 (54%) .

 Arthur Fils moves out to a 1-0 lead over Ben Shelton in the opening set at the Nitto ATP Finals . Serving numbers show Shelton landing 2/3 (67%) of first deliveries compared to 4/4 (100%) for Fils .

 2:42 PM ET 42 minutes ago First serve underway between Shelton and Fils (0-0, Set 1)
 Play is officially underway on the hard court at Inalpi Arena ! Ben Shelton and Arthur Fils open the first set (0-0) in Group Stage action at the Nitto ATP Finals .
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 2:30 PM ET an hour ago Stadium 1 schedule update: Shelton vs Fils up next on court
 Play on the main show court at Inalpi Arena runs on a rolling "followed by" schedule at the Nitto ATP Finals : Ben Shelton and Arthur Fils take the court right after the preceding match concludes.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 2:21 PM ET an hour ago Players standing by at Inalpi Arena: Ben Shelton vs Arthur Fils next on court
 Ben Shelton and Arthur Fils are ready in the tunnel area at Inalpi Arena to step onto the hard court for introductions and practice rallies at the Nitto ATP Finals .
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 2:14 PM ET an hour ago 15 minutes to scheduled window between Shelton and Fils
 Tournament officials are standing by at Inalpi Arena ahead of player walkouts and the coin toss at the net between Ben Shelton and Arthur Fils once the show court is clear.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 2:07 PM ET an hour ago 20 minutes to start window: off-court preparation for Shelton and Fils
 Ben Shelton and Arthur Fils are completing their off-court activation routines at Inalpi Arena ahead of first serve in the Nitto ATP Finals .
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 2:00 PM ET an hour ago 30 minutes to scheduled start at Inalpi Arena: Ben Shelton vs Arthur Fils
 We are 30 minutes away from the scheduled start window at Inalpi Arena (Inalpi Arena) as Ben Shelton and Arthur Fils prepare for their Nitto ATP Finals clash.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 1:56 PM ET an hour ago Final court check ahead of Shelton vs Fils
 Players are on site at Inalpi Arena as Ben Shelton and Arthur Fils get ready for action in Nitto ATP Finals .
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 1:39 PM ET 2 hours ago Players approaching walkout at Inalpi Arena for 2:30 p.m. ET
 Lights are dimming inside Inalpi Arena in Turin for the evening John McEnroe Group clash between No. 3 Ben Shelton and No. 6 Arthur Fils. Coin toss, opening service holds and Set 1 game-by-game updates follow next on VAVEL USA.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 1:17 PM ET 2 hours ago Indoor hard-court edge from Basel 2024
 While Fils edged their lone outdoor clash in Tokyo, Shelton won their only indoor hard-court meeting in straight sets at Basel (6-3, 7-6), holding serve throughout both sets.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 12:56 PM ET 2 hours ago 84 combined tour victories entering the season finale
 Shelton arrives in Turin at 45-19 on the 2026 season alongside a US Open final run, while tournament debutant Fils stands 39-16 after cracking the Top 10 for the first time this summer.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 12:35 PM ET 3 hours ago $405,000 and 200 ATP points at stake tonight in Turin
 Each round-robin singles win at the $15.75 million 2026 Nitto ATP Finals pays $405,000 and adds 200 PIF ATP Rankings points toward year-end seeding for the 2027 Australian Open.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 12:14 PM ET 3 hours ago Three tiebreaks played across five tour-level sets in 2024
 Every previous ATP Tour meeting between Shelton and Fils went down to a tiebreak: Fils took Tokyo 7-5, 6-7 (5), 7-6 (2) outdoors before Shelton answered 6-3, 7-6 (9) indoors in Basel.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:53 AM ET 4 hours ago Six combined ATP titles won by Shelton and Fils in 2026
 No. 3 seed Ben Shelton won four tournaments in 2026 (Dallas, Munich, Stuttgart, Montreal Masters 1000) while No. 6 seed Arthur Fils won two (Barcelona, Cincinnati Masters 1000), bringing six 2026 trophies onto Center Court tonight.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:30 AM ET 4 hours ago How to watch Ben Shelton vs Arthur Fils: US start time and live stream
 Ben Shelton vs Arthur Fils starts not before 2:30 p.m. ET / 11:30 a.m. PT (19:30 UTC, 20:30 CET) today, Sunday, Nov. 15, on Center Court at Inalpi Arena in Turin, Italy. Tennis Channel broadcasts exclusive live television coverage across the United States, with live streaming via the Tennis Channel app and TennisTV internationally.
 Best-of-three tiebreak sets close out Opening Night in the John McEnroe Group.
 Stay right here on VAVEL USA for game-by-game score updates, ace totals, first-serve percentages and live Group Stage standings from Turin.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:30 AM ET 4 hours ago Doubles chemistry turns into singles familiarity across the net
 Few rivalries on tour carry warmer off-court camaraderie or sharper tactical knowledge than Shelton vs Fils.
 Having teamed up in tour doubles draws and practiced together frequently at Masters 1000 stops from Indian Wells to Paris, neither man hides any serving tells from the other. Break points indoors between two top-tier servers are scarce: in their Basel indoor semifinal, Shelton did not drop serve once across two sets while fending off every look Fils generated.
 For French tennis, 22-year-old Fils represents the first solo singles debutant at the ATP Finals in Turin since France last placed a Top-8 contender on indoor Italian hard court, drawing noisy tricolor support inside the 12,000-seat bowl.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:30 AM ET 4 hours ago Two Americans in Turin's elite eight for 2026
 With third seed Shelton in the John McEnroe Group and seventh seed Frances Tiafoe in the Ivan Lendl Group, American men's tennis places two contenders inside the season-ending eight-man singles draw in Turin.
 No American man has hoisted the season-ending singles trophy since Pete Sampras defeated Andre Agassi in Hanover back in 1999 (with James Blake reaching the Shanghai final in 2006 and Taylor Fritz finishing runner-up in Turin in 2024). Shelton's four-title 2026 surge positions the former Florida Gator NCAA champion as the highest-seeded American in Piedmont this week.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:30 AM ET 4 hours ago Indoor court speed at Inalpi Arena (240 meters altitude) favors first-strike serving
 Turin sits roughly 240 meters above sea level in northwestern Italy, giving Inalpi Arena's indoor Greenset hard court brisk pace through the air and a low, clean bounce off the surface.
 Left-handed 140-plus mph first serves from Shelton regularly produce unreturned free points indoors, particularly when he mixes body serves on the deuce side with kick serves jumping high into Fils' two-handed backhand. Fils counters by standing tight to the baseline on second-serve returns and ripping inside-out forehands before Shelton can sneak to the net behind serve-and-volley plays.
 First-strike rallies of four shots or fewer account for well over 65 percent of points on this Turin surface, magnifying every mini-break once sets reach 6-6.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:30 AM ET 4 hours ago Record $15.75 million Turin purse and 200 ATP points per round-robin win
 Running Nov. 15-22 inside Inalpi Arena, the 2026 Nitto ATP Finals feature an all-time record $15,750,000 total prize purse.
 Completing all three round-robin singles matches pays a $338,000 participation fee, while every group-stage victory awards an additional $405,000 in prize money plus 200 PIF ATP Rankings points. Semifinal winners collect $1,206,000 (400 points) and next Sunday's championship match winner earns $2,412,000 (500 points), putting a staggering $5,171,000 jackpot and 1,500 points on the table for an undefeated champion.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:30 AM ET 4 hours ago John McEnroe Group stakes alongside Zverev and Jodar
 Drawn into the four-man John McEnroe Group, Shelton (No. 3) and Fils (No. 6) share round-robin duty with Year-End World No. 1 Alexander Zverev (No. 1) and Next Gen sensation Rafael Jodar (No. 8), who opened the afternoon session in Turin earlier today.
 In a four-player group where only the top two finishers advance to Saturday's semifinals, tonight's match functions as a virtual swing match for a knockout berth. Dropping an opening round-robin contest in straight sets leaves the loser facing must-win pressure against Zverev over the next four days, whereas a two-set victory banks an immediate set-percentage cushion.
 Over in the Ivan Lendl Group, play opens Monday featuring No. 2 Carlos Alcaraz , No. 4 Daniil Medvedev , No. 5 Italian crowd favorite Flavio Cobolli and No. 7 American Frances Tiafoe.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:30 AM ET 4 hours ago Tour-level head-to-head split 1-1 after classic Tokyo and Basel duels
 Whenever Shelton and Fils share a hard court, tiebreaks are practically guaranteed.
 Their two main-draw ATP Tour clashes in autumn 2024 split right down the middle at 1-1, featuring three tiebreak sets across five total frames. In the quarterfinals of the ATP 500 in Tokyo outdoors, Fils outlasted Shelton 7-5, 6-7 (5), 7-6 (2) in a bruising baseline firefight. Three weeks later indoors at the Swiss Indoors in Basel, Shelton flipped the script in the semifinals with a 6-3, 7-6 (9) straight-sets victory, saving set points in a 20-point breaker (adding to an earlier Laver Cup victory that gives Shelton a 2-1 edge across all official events).
 Crucially for tonight's conditions at Inalpi Arena, Basel was contested indoors on rapid hard court, where Shelton's lefty slice wide to the backhand in the ad court skids below knee height.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:30 AM ET 4 hours ago Cincinnati Masters 1000 champion: how Arthur Fils earned his Turin debut at 22
 Arthur Fils arrives in Piedmont as one of two tournament debutants in the 2026 singles field alongside 20-year-old Spaniard Rafael Jodar.
 Posting a 39-16 match record across the season, the explosive 22-year-old Frenchman captured two prestigious trophies to reach five career tour titles. First came a clay-court ATP 500 triumph at the Barcelona Open Banc Sabadell in April; then came his career breakthrough in August at the Cincinnati Open, where Fils defeated Shelton's compatriot Frances Tiafoe in the final to lift his maiden ATP Masters 1000 shield and crack the Top 10 up to a career-high World No. 7.
 Heavy topspin forehand acceleration and fearless second-serve returns turned Fils into a nightmare matchup on fast courts throughout the North American summer swing.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:30 AM ET 4 hours ago Four 2026 titles and a US Open final: inside Shelton's rise to the No. 3 seed
 No American man has assembled a trophy haul in 2026 quite like 24-year-old left-hander Ben Shelton.
 Across a 45-19 tour campaign, Shelton captured four ATP singles crowns across three different surfaces to lift his career tally to seven titles: indoors on hard court at the Dallas Open (ATP 500), on clay at the BMW Open in Munich (ATP 500), on grass at Stuttgart (ATP 250) and outdoors on hard court at the National Bank Open in Montreal for his second Masters 1000 title. Even bigger, he stormed into his first career Grand Slam singles final at the 2026 US Open in Flushing Meadows before finishing runner-up to world No. 1 Alexander Zverev.
 Having peaked at a career-high No. 4 in the PIF ATP Rankings earlier this year, Shelton enters his second Nitto ATP Finals appearance seeded No. 3 in the elite eight-man draw.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:30 AM ET 4 hours ago Ben Shelton and Arthur Fils headline Sunday night's John McEnroe Group session in Turin
 Good afternoon and welcome to VAVEL USA's live courtside coverage of Ben Shelton vs Arthur Fils from Inalpi Arena in Turin, Italy. Evening singles action on Day 1 of the 2026 Nitto ATP Finals gets underway today, Sunday, Nov. 15, with first serve on Center Court scheduled for not before 2:30 p.m. ET (11:30 a.m. PT, 19:30 UTC and 20:30 CET local time) live on Tennis Channel.
 Close friends and occasional doubles partners square off under the Turin lights with massive Group Stage leverage.
 Third-seeded American Ben Shelton , 24, returns to the season-ending championship after a four-title, 45-19 campaign that carried him to a maiden Grand Slam final in New York. Across the net stands sixth-seeded Frenchman Arthur Fils , 22, making his Nitto ATP Finals debut on the strength of a 39-16 record and his first Masters 1000 crown in Cincinnati.
 Coin toss, first serve and game-by-game score updates follow right here through match point.
